title: pilosella piloselloides
intro: Pilosella piloselloides, commonly known as Mouse-ear Hawk's-beard, is a perennial plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). It is a flowering plant known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella piloselloides are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenoids. These compounds may contribute to the plant's anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, although further research is needed to fully understand its therapeutic potential.
